text: What does it mean when the girl wants to text, but doesn't want to meet in real life? Let's say you met this girl online. She looks great, chats are fun, vibes are solid. You ask her out, she says no. You wait, chat some more, ask again, she says no again. But she still texts you, sends good morning messages, and asks how your day was. So you're thinking, she must be interested, right? Wrong. If a girl refuses to meet up twice, she is not serious. She might enjoy your attention. She might be bored. She might love the feeling of someone chasing her. But that doesn't mean she's interested in you. You are not her therapist. You are not her fan club. And you are definitely not her emotional support texting service. You want real connection? Then you need real life effort. If she won't even get up from her couch to meet you, what are we even doing here? So stop overanalyzing. Stop making excuses for her behavior. You are not here to impress someone who treats you like a background noise. Here is the rule. If she won't show up, you move on. No debate, no drama, just moving on. There is always someone out there who will match your real energy in real life. Follow and like for more advice. Thank you.
